snippet.title: Systemic War - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270430/Systemic_War/

Lead your nation in Systemic War, a modern grand strategy game (2008–2025), using a macroeconomic model with exchange rates, diplomacy, and hybrid warfare. Engage in kinetic warfare on the strategic map, then shift to RTS battles at focal points.

Systemic War Demo launches October 13, on Windows PC.
